scenes.title: Level 4: Changing chords
scenes.subtitle: G, C and smooth changes
lines: Learn G major, C major, and how to switch between them smoothly — the key to playing real songs.

scenes.heading: In this level
lines: After this level, you'll be able to change between G and C major chords smoothly and confidently.
You'll practice fast, clean transitions using a classic one-minute drill.
These skills will help you play simple songs with clear, connected chord changes.
Today we'll learn two new chords: G major and C major.
They're simple to play and will open up many songs.
Let's start with the secret to fast, smooth chord changes — the foundation of great guitar playing.
